plugins.name: thunderphone
plugins.description: Build, connect, test, and migrate ThunderPhone voice agents with REST and MCP.

skills.name: add-knowledge
skills.description: Create, import, search, update, or attach ThunderPhone knowledge. Use when someone asks to upload documents, import a URL, create a knowledge base, wait for indexing, search retrieved content, attach knowledge_base_ids or knowledge_document_ids to an agent, or debug missing answers.
skills.description_zh: 创建、导入、搜索、更新或关联 ThunderPhone 知识库与文档，检查索引状态、检索内容及代理知识关联，也用于排查缺失回答。

skills.name: build-tool-integration
skills.description: Give a ThunderPhone agent a function tool, HTTP API connection, webhook-style tool, or remote MCP server. Use when someone asks to connect an external API, define an OpenAPI tool, test an integration request, attach mcp_server_ids, sync MCP tools, or debug tool calls.
skills.description_zh: 为 ThunderPhone 代理配置函数工具、HTTP/OpenAPI 接口、webhook 类工具或远程 MCP 服务，并测试请求、同步工具和排查调用。

skills.name: create-agent
skills.description: Create, configure, update, deploy, or discard a ThunderPhone voice agent. Use when someone asks to build an agent, choose Spark versus Bolt versus Storm, select a language or voice, call POST /v1/agents, or understand draft and deployed revisions.
skills.description_zh: 创建、配置、更新、部署或丢弃 ThunderPhone 语音代理，选择模型档位、语言和声音，并区分草稿与已部署修订。

skills.name: embed-web-widget
skills.description: Add, configure, style, or debug the ThunderPhone web voice widget. Use when someone asks about @thunderphone/widget, ThunderPhoneWidget, useThunderPhone, the CDN script, pk_live_ publishable keys, allowed domains, widget sessions, React integration, or a headless call UI.
skills.description_zh: 添加、设置样式或排查 ThunderPhone 网页语音组件，涵盖 React、CDN 脚本、公开密钥、域名限制、会话及自定义通话界面。

skills.name: get-phone-number
skills.description: Buy, import, provision, label, or attach a phone number in ThunderPhone. Use when someone asks for a ThunderPhone-managed number, bring-your-own-carrier SIP setup, VoIP connection search, inbound or outbound agent assignment, number limits, porting, or regulatory requirements.
headings: Get and configure a phone number
skills.description_zh: 在 ThunderPhone 中购买、导入、配置、标记或关联电话号码，处理自有运营商 SIP、VoIP 连接、呼入呼出代理分配、携号转网和监管要求。

skills.name: handle-inbound-calls
skills.description: Configure and verify inbound calls for a ThunderPhone agent. Use when someone asks to route a number to an agent, receive inbound calls, inject call variables, use dynamic call configuration, personalize greetings, or debug why an incoming call reaches the wrong behavior.
skills.description_zh: 配置并验证 ThunderPhone 代理的呼入流程，关联号码、注入通话变量、设置动态配置与问候语，排查呼入行为异常。

skills.name: migrate-from-bland
skills.description: Import and validate Bland AI pathways or agents in ThunderPhone. Use when someone asks to migrate from Bland, create a Bland agent-import job, review pathway-node mappings, identify number or webhook gaps, commit selected imports, or compare source and ThunderPhone calls before cutover.
skills.description_zh: 将 Bland AI 路径或代理导入 ThunderPhone，核对节点映射、号码和 webhook 缺口，选择提交项目，并在切换前比较通话表现。

skills.name: migrate-from-elevenlabs
skills.description: Import and validate ElevenLabs conversational agents in ThunderPhone. Use when someone asks to migrate from ElevenLabs Agents, create an ElevenLabs import job, review voice or knowledge mappings, identify client-tool or MCP gaps, commit selected items, or run side-by-side calls before cutover.
skills.description_zh: 将 ElevenLabs 对话代理导入 ThunderPhone，核对声音、知识、客户端工具及 MCP 映射，选择提交项目，并在切换前开展并行通话验证。

skills.name: migrate-from-retell
skills.description: Import and validate Retell AI agents in ThunderPhone. Use when someone asks to migrate from Retell, create a Retell agent-import job, review response-engine or flow mappings, identify manual tool and number work, commit selected items, or run parity tests before cutover.
skills.description_zh: 将 Retell AI 代理导入 ThunderPhone，审核响应引擎或流程映射、人工工具与号码迁移事项，并在切换前做一致性测试。

skills.name: migrate-from-vapi
skills.description: Import and validate Vapi assistants in ThunderPhone. Use when someone asks to migrate from Vapi, create a Vapi agent-import job, choose imported items, review mapped prompts or tools, identify manual migration gaps, commit an import, or run side-by-side tests.
skills.description_zh: 将 Vapi 助手导入 ThunderPhone，核对提示与工具映射、识别人工迁移缺口、选择提交项目，并进行并行比较测试。

skills.name: place-outbound-calls
skills.description: Place, monitor, or troubleshoot an outbound ThunderPhone call. Use when someone asks about POST /v1/call, TCPA confirmation, insufficient balance, caller and recipient numbers, call variables, idempotency, polling status, transcripts, or when to use a campaign.
skills.description_zh: 发起、监控或排查 ThunderPhone 呼出通话，处理号码、余额、TCPA 确认、变量、幂等性、状态轮询及转录，也判断是否适合采用批量活动。

skills.name: run-campaign
skills.description: Run a consent-based ThunderPhone outbound campaign to people who agreed to be called (appointment reminders, callbacks, follow-ups) - create it, load contacts, start, pause, stop, monitor, or troubleshoot. Use when someone asks about campaign setup, contact CSV or JSON imports, calling windows, consent and compliance controls, consent_to_charge, campaign actions, or stats.
skills.description_zh: 对已同意接听的联系人运行 ThunderPhone 呼出活动，支持创建、导入联系人、启动、暂停、停止和统计；核对呼叫时段、同意及收费控制。

skills.name: setup-api-key
skills.description: Set up, rotate, verify, or troubleshoot a ThunderPhone API key. Use when someone asks where ThunderPhone keys live, how to configure THUNDERPHONE_API_KEY, how to authenticate a REST request, or why an API request returns 401 or 403.
headings: Set up a ThunderPhone API key
skills.description_zh: 配置、轮换、验证或排查 ThunderPhone API 密钥，处理环境变量、REST 身份验证及 401/403 错误。

skills.name: setup-webhooks
skills.description: Create, test, verify, rotate, or troubleshoot ThunderPhone webhook endpoints. Use when someone asks for call events, incoming or complete notifications, webhook signing secrets, X-ThunderPhone-Signature verification, HMAC code in Python or TypeScript, retries, or duplicate delivery handling.
skills.description_zh: 创建、验证或排查 ThunderPhone webhook 端点，处理通话事件、HMAC 签名校验、重试和重复投递。

skills.name: test-agent
skills.description: Test, grade, debug, and improve a ThunderPhone agent in a closed loop. Use when someone asks to generate scenarios, execute test runs, call /v1/simulations, use legacy test calls, inspect transcripts or grades, fix a prompt after failures, or decide whether an agent is ready to deploy.
headings: Test an agent in a closed loop
What a good pass looks like
skills.description_zh: 对 ThunderPhone 代理开展场景生成、模拟测试、评分、转录检查及提示修复，形成测试改进闭环并判断部署准备情况。

skills.name: thunderphone-mcp-setup
skills.description: Configure or troubleshoot the ThunderPhone MCP server in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Desktop, or Gemini CLI. Use when someone asks to add https://api.thunderphone.com/v1/mcp, set Bearer [已隐藏], choose MCP versus REST, inspect MCP coverage, or verify a coding-agent connection.
skills.description_zh: 在 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code、Claude Desktop 或 Gemini CLI 中配置和排查 ThunderPhone MCP，验证身份认证、工具覆盖和连接。

skills.name: thunderphone-prompt-builder
skills.description: Draft, review, translate, or validate a production ThunderPhone voice-agent prompt. Use when someone asks for prompt engineering, a bilingual phone prompt, TTS-friendly instructions, a prompt language check, or a safe prompt template for a ThunderPhone agent.
skills.description_zh: 起草、审核、翻译或验证 ThunderPhone 生产语音代理提示，处理双语电话场景、适合语音合成的指令及语言一致性。

skills.name: use-with-livekit
skills.description: Connect LiveKit Agents to ThunderPhone Realtime. Use when someone asks for the ThunderPhone LiveKit plugin, the current GitHub fork install, livekit-agents compatibility, an OpenAI Realtime endpoint swap, saved agent_id sessions, or LiveKit voice-agent troubleshooting.
skills.description_zh: 将 LiveKit Agents 接入 ThunderPhone Realtime，配置插件和保存的代理会话，检查兼容性、端点替换及语音代理故障。

skills.name: use-with-openai-realtime
skills.description: Point an OpenAI Realtime-compatible client at ThunderPhone. Use when someone asks for the ThunderPhone Realtime WebSocket URL, session.update events, saved agent_id versus inline config, endpoint swapping, server-side authentication, or migration from an OpenAI Realtime client.
skills.description_zh: 将兼容 OpenAI Realtime 的客户端连接到 ThunderPhone，处理 WebSocket、会话事件、已保存代理或内联配置、服务端身份验证及端点迁移。

skills.name: use-with-pipecat
skills.description: Connect Pipecat to the ThunderPhone Realtime endpoint. Use when someone asks for pipecat-thunderphone, ThunderPhoneRealtimeLLMService, an OpenAI Realtime-compatible Pipecat service, package installation, saved agent_id configuration, or Pipecat voice-session troubleshooting.
skills.description_zh: 将 Pipecat 接入 ThunderPhone Realtime，配置配套服务、安装包和保存的代理标识，并排查语音会话问题。
